reader.requirement: At --std 85 an addend written n times in a SUM clause (a subtotalled item or a crossfooted or rolled sum counter) is added n times, and a detail named n times in an UPON phrase (qualified or not) makes each GENERATE of that detail add the addends n times; UPON operands must name a detail of the same report.

reader.notes: Duplicate generate-driven addends fold into one ADD closure that sums every written addend; duplicate UPON operands are counted by Fires; duplicate rolled/crossfooted counters register one addition per appearance. Class f (size error) was not decisive here: p4b's PIC 9 counter SUM Y Y overflowed and printed 6, a result 1985 leaves undefined (no ON SIZE ERROR); classes a and e do not apply.
